train.label: Explicit direct-record field equality only:1same requested/reported field,0other reported field,nullderived/diagnostic/broad or unbound. Relevant false claims remain relevant. Any original source capture UNKNOWN is excluded, not a zero field.
train.numeric_balance: For each binary goal and competing role pair: both observed fields claim measured value and the other field value; identical value multiset under each goal. Duplicate labels must be consistent, never counted as independent tasks.
train.wording: Four exposed aliases/four separately authored captions/EN+PT report language, all32combinations in each split; both query languages for every fixture. Shuffle factorial independently from state modes/values using wording-only seed. Train2fixtures percombination,validation1; query wrapper frames differ, primitive aliases/captions shared.
train.report: Complete JSON or Tool report with entity,level,measurement,value; separately chosen form/level. No annotation role IDs/ground truth/commands in input strings.
train.population_recipe: Every52competingpair in every fixture, bothquerylanguages and bothdirections, twoobservedfields, measured/value-swapvariants. SemanticUNKNOWN each18primitive x3kinds x2querylanguages perfixture, one structuralUNKNOWN perquerylanguage. Fixed direct query template chosen by fixture group and pair index, semantic template by fixture group and role index. No label derivation or scoring yet.
train.scope: Actual authored development, all18primitives/three sources and prior exposed vocabulary; no source/domain/new-pair confirmation. Role graph is a planned coverage graph, not yet emitted-label evidence. Derived/diagnostic/general LCC utility unknown; direct-field equality is narrower than useful LCC context.
train.old_finals: All old finals are exposed development; fresh confirmation must be separately reserved before scoring a candidate
train.revision_reason: Before labels/forwards, qualify every UDP received counter query and caption as observed within recorded receiver read budget; these counts cannot claim all arrivals or packet loss. Raw measurement sources/values unchanged.
